versos.grego: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες Τίς ἄρα μείζων ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν;

controles.web: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
controles.kjv: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
controles.livre: Naquela hora os discípulos se aproximaram de Jesus, e perguntaram: Ora, quem é o maior no Reino dos céus?

versos.grego: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος παιδίον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν

controles.web: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in their midst,
controles.kjv: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
controles.livre: Então Jesus chamou a si uma criança, e a pôs no meio deles,

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ στραφῆτε καὶ γένησθε ὡς τὰ παιδία, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
controles.kjv: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
controles.livre: e disse: Em verdade vos digo, que se vós não converterdes, e fordes como crianças, de maneira nenhuma entrareis no Reino dos céus.

versos.grego: ὅστις οὖν ταπεινώσει ἑαυτὸν ὡς τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μείζων ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
controles.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
controles.livre: Assim, qualquer um que for humilde como esta criança, este é o maior no reino dos céus.

versos.grego: καὶ ὃς ἐὰν δέξηται ἓν παιδίον τοιοῦτο ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐμὲ δέχεται·

controles.web: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
controles.kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
controles.livre: E qualquer um que receber a uma criança como esta em meu nome, recebe a mim.

versos.grego: ὃς δ’ ἂν σκανδαλίσῃ ἕνα τῶν μικρῶν τούτων τῶν πιστευόντων εἰς ἐμέ, συμφέρει αὐτῷ ἵνα κρεμασθῇ μύλος ὀνικὸς περὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ καταποντισθῇ ἐν τῷ πελάγει τῆς θαλάσσης.

controles.web: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him that a huge millstone should be hung around his neck, and that he should be sunk in the depths of the sea.
controles.kjv: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
controles.livre: Mas qualquer um que conduzir ao escândalo a um destes pequeninos que creem em mim, melhor lhe fora que uma grande pedra de moinho lhe fosse pendurada ao pescoço, e se afundasse no fundo do mar.

versos.grego: Οὐαὶ τῷ κόσμῳ ἀπὸ τῶν σκανδάλων· ἀνάγκη γὰρ ἐλθεῖν τὰ σκάνδαλα, πλὴν οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ δι’ οὗ τὸ σκάνδαλον ἔρχεται.

controles.web: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
controles.kjv: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
controles.livre: Ai do mundo por causa dos escândalos! Pois é necessário que os escândalos venham, mas ai da pessoa por quem o escândalo vem!

versos.grego: Εἰ δὲ ἡ χείρ σου ἢ ὁ πούς σου σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔκκοψον αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ· καλόν σοί ἐστιν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν κυλλὸν ἢ χωλόν, ἢ δύο χεῖρας ἢ δύο πόδας ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ αἰώνιον.

controles.web: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
controles.kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
controles.livre: Portanto, se a tua mão ou o teu pé te conduz ao escândalo,  corta-os, e lança-os de ti; melhor te é entrar aleijado ou manco na vida do que, tendo duas mãos ou dois pés, ser lançado no fogo eterno.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔξελε αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ· καλόν σοί ἐστιν μονόφθαλμον εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν, ἢ δύο ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς τὴν γέενναν τοῦ πυρός.

controles.web: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehennaof fire.
controles.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
controles.livre: E se o teu olho te conduz ao escândalo, arranca-o, e lança-o de ti. Melhor te é entrar com um olho na vida do que, tendo dois olhos, ser lançado no inferno de fogo.

versos.grego: Ὁρᾶτε μὴ καταφρονήσητε ἑνὸς τῶν μικρῶν τούτων· λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτῶν ἐν οὐρανοῖς διὰ παντὸς βλέπουσι τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ Πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς.

controles.web: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
controles.kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
controles.livre: Olhai para que não desprezeis a algum destes pequeninos; porque eu vos digo que os seus anjos nos céus sempre veem a face do meu Pai, que está nos céus.

versos.grego: Τί ὑμῖν δοκεῖ; ἐὰν γένηταί τινι ἀνθρώπῳ ἑκατὸν πρόβατα καὶ πλανηθῇ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν, οὐχὶ ἀφήσει τὰ ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη καὶ πορευθεὶς ζητεῖ τὸ πλανώμενον;

controles.web: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
controles.kjv: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
controles.livre: Que vos parece? Se alguém tivesse cem ovelhas, e uma delas se desviasse, por acaso não iria ele pelos montes, deixando as noventa e nove, em busca da desviada?

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν γένηται εὑρεῖν αὐτό, ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι χαίρει ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μᾶλλον ἢ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα τοῖς μὴ πεπλανημένοις.

controles.web: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
controles.kjv: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
controles.livre: E se acontecesse de achá-la, em verdade vos digo que ele se alegra mais daquela, do que das noventa e nove que se não desviaram.

versos.grego: οὕτως οὐκ ἔστιν θέλημα ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Πατρὸς ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν μικρῶν τούτων.

controles.web: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
controles.kjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
controles.livre: Da mesma maneira, não é da vontade do vosso Pai, que está nos céus, que um sequer destes pequeninos se perca.

versos.grego: Ἐὰν δὲ ἁμαρτήσῃ ὁ ἀδελφός σου, ὕπαγε ἔλεγξον αὐτὸν μεταξὺ σοῦ καὶ αὐτοῦ μόνου. ἐάν σου ἀκούσῃ, ἐκέρδησας τὸν ἀδελφόν σου·

controles.web: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
controles.kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
controles.livre: Porém, se teu irmão pecar, vai repreendê-lo entre ti e ele só; se te ouvir, ganhaste o teu irmão.

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἀκούσῃ, παράλαβε μετὰ σοῦ ἔτι ἕνα ἢ δύο, ἵνα ἐπὶ στόματος δύο μαρτύρων ἢ τριῶν σταθῇ πᾶν ῥῆμα·

controles.web: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
controles.kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
controles.livre: Mas se não ouvir, toma ainda contigo um ou dois, para que toda palavra se confirme pela boca de duas ou três testemunhas.

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ παρακούσῃ αὐτῶν, εἰπὸν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ· ἐὰν δὲ καὶ τῆς ἐκκλησίας παρακούσῃ, ἔστω σοι ὥσπερ ὁ ἐθνικὸς καὶ ὁ τελώνης.

controles.web: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
controles.kjv: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
controles.livre: E se não lhes der ouvidos, comunica à igreja; e se também não der ouvidos à igreja, considera-o como gentio e cobrador de impostos.

versos.grego: Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅσα ἐὰν δήσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται δεδεμένα ἐν οὐρανῷ, καὶ ὅσα ἐὰν λύσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται λελυμένα ἐν οὐρανῷ.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo que tudo o que vós ligardes na terra será ligado  no céu; e tudo o que desligardes na terra será desligado  no céu.

versos.grego: Πάλιν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν δύο συμφωνήσωσιν ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς περὶ παντὸς πράγματος οὗ ἐὰν αἰτήσωνται, γενήσεται αὐτοῖς παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς.

controles.web: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
controles.kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
controles.livre: E digo-vos tambémem verdade que, se dois de vós concordarem na terra acerca de qualquer coisa que pedirem, isso lhes será feito por meu Pai, que está nos céus.

versos.grego: οὗ γάρ εἰσιν δύο ἢ τρεῖς συνηγμένοι εἰς τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα, ἐκεῖ εἰμι ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in their midst.”
controles.kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
controles.livre: Pois onde dois ou três estiverem reunidos em meu nome, ali eu estou no meio deles.

versos.grego: Τότε προσελθὼν ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Κύριε, ποσάκις ἁμαρτήσει εἰς ἐμὲ ὁ ἀδελφός μου καὶ ἀφήσω αὐτῷ; ἕως ἑπτάκις;

controles.web: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
controles.kjv: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
controles.livre: Então Pedro aproximou-se , e perguntou-lhe: Senhor, até quantas vezes meu irmão pecará contra mim, e eu lhe perdoarei? Até sete?

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐ λέγω σοι ἕως ἑπτάκις, ἀλλὰ ἕως ἑβδομηκοντάκις ἑπτά.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
controles.livre: Jesus lhe respondeu: Eu não te digo até sete, mas sim até setenta vezes sete.

versos.grego: Διὰ τοῦτο ὡμοιώθη ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ βασιλεῖ ὃς ἠθέλησεν συνᾶραι λόγον μετὰ τῶν δούλων αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who wanted to reconcile accounts with his servants.
controles.kjv: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
controles.livre: Por isso o Reino dos céus é comparável a um certo rei, que quis fazer acerto de contas com os seus servos.

versos.grego: ἀρξαμένου δὲ αὐτοῦ συναίρειν προσήχθη εἷς αὐτῷ ὀφειλέτης μυρίων ταλάντων.

controles.web: When he had begun to reconcile, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
controles.kjv: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
controles.livre: E começando a fazer acerto de contas, foi-lhe apresentado um que lhe devia dez mil talentos.

versos.grego: μὴ ἔχοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀποδοῦναι ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος πραθῆναι καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ τέκνα καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἔχει, καὶ ἀποδοθῆναι.

controles.web: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
controles.kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
controles.livre: Como ele não tinha com que pagar, o seu senhor mandou que ele, sua mulher, filhos, e tudo quanto tinha fossem vendidos para se fazer o pagamento.

versos.grego: πεσὼν οὖν ὁ δοῦλος προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων Μακροθύμησον ἐπ’ ἐμοί, καὶ πάντα ἀποδώσω σοι.

controles.web: The servant therefore fell down and kneeled before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’
controles.kjv: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
controles.livre: Então aquele servo caiu e ficou prostrado diante dele, dizendo: “Tem paciência comigo, e tudo te pagarei”.

versos.grego: σπλαγχνισθεὶς δὲ ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου ἐκείνου ἀπέλυσεν αὐτόν, καὶ τὸ δάνειον ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.
controles.kjv: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
controles.livre: O senhor daquele servo compadeceu-se dele, então o soltou e lhe perdoou a dívida.

versos.grego: ἐξελθὼν δὲ ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος εὗρεν ἕνα τῶν συνδούλων αὐτοῦ, ὃς ὤφειλεν αὐτῷ ἑκατὸν δηνάρια, καὶ κρατήσας αὐτὸν ἔπνιγεν λέγων Ἀπόδος εἴ τι ὀφείλεις.

controles.web: “But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow servants, who owed him one hundred denarii,and he grabbed him, and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
controles.kjv: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
controles.livre: Todavia, depois daquele servo sair, achou um servo, colega seu, que lhe devia cem denários;  então o agarrou e o sufocou, dizendo: “Paga o que me deves!”

versos.grego: πεσὼν οὖν ὁ σύνδουλος αὐτοῦ παρεκάλει αὐτὸν λέγων Μακροθύμησον ἐπ’ ἐμοί, καὶ ἀποδώσω σοι.

controles.web: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
controles.kjv: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
controles.livre: Então o seu colega se prostrou, e lhe suplicou, dizendo: “Tem paciência comigo, e tudo te pagarei”.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ οὐκ ἤθελεν, ἀλλὰ ἀπελθὼν ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακὴν ἕως ἀποδῷ τὸ ὀφειλόμενον.

controles.web: He would not, but went and cast him into prison, until he should pay back that which was due.
controles.kjv: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
controles.livre: Mas ele não quis. Em vez disso foi lançá-lo na prisão até que pagasse a dívida.

versos.grego: ἰδόντες οὖν οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτοῦ τὰ γενόμενα ἐλυπήθησαν σφόδρα, καὶ ἐλθόντες διεσάφησαν τῷ κυρίῳ ἑαυτῶν πάντα τὰ γενόμενα.

controles.web: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told to their lord all that was done.
controles.kjv: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
controles.livre: Quando os servos, colegas dele, viram o que se passava, entristeceram-se muito. Então vieram denunciar ao seu senhor tudo o que havia se passado.

versos.grego: τότε προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ λέγει αὐτῷ Δοῦλε πονηρέ, πᾶσαν τὴν ὀφειλὴν ἐκείνην ἀφῆκά σοι, ἐπεὶ παρεκάλεσάς με·

controles.web: Then his lord called him in, and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt, because you begged me.
controles.kjv: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
controles.livre: Assim o seu senhor o chamou, e lhe disse: “Servo mau! Toda aquela dívida te perdoei, porque me suplicaste.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔδει καὶ σὲ ἐλεῆσαι τὸν σύνδουλόν σου, ὡς κἀγὼ σὲ ἠλέησα;

controles.web: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
controles.kjv: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
controles.livre: Não tinhas tu a obrigação de ter tido misericórdia do sevo colega teu, assim como eu tive misericórdia de ti?”

versos.grego: καὶ ὀργισθεὶς ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν τοῖς βασανισταῖς ἕως οὗ ἀποδῷ πᾶν τὸ ὀφειλόμενον αὐτῷ.

controles.web: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, until he should pay all that was due to him.
controles.kjv: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
controles.livre: E, enfurecido, o seu senhor o entregou aos torturadores até que pagasse tudo o que lhe devia.

versos.grego: Οὕτως καὶ ὁ Πατήρ μου ὁ οὐράνιος ποιήσει ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ ἀφῆτε ἕκαστος τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν καρδιῶν ὑμῶν.

controles.web: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
controles.kjv: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
controles.livre: Assim também meu Pai celestial vos fará, se não perdoardes de coração cada um ao seu irmão.
